headline: Circular migration: Paraguay opens new call for 200 farmworkers to go to Spain to work - National - ABC Color
summary: Paraguay has opened a new call to select 200 agricultural workers for Spain under a circular migration programme. The initiative follows a successful pilot launched in March, according to the Ministry of Labour.
why: Circular labour migration programmes link seasonal agricultural demand in Europe with labour supply in Latin America, affecting remittances and farm labour markets.
